# Georgina Tilley

**Headline:** Director of Frontline Medical Affairs Excellence NW Europe at Novo Nordisk, MSLA committee member
**Current role:** Director Global Medical Strategy And Execution
**Location:** Greater Bristol Area, United Kingdom
**Experience:** 19 years 6 months
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/georgina-tilley-phd-39802251 · 2,773 followers
**Description:** Pharmaceutical Industry Professional with vast experience within the Diabetes, Obesity and CV space. Knowledge of leading teams through pre-launch, launch and post-marketing. Leader of field based medical teams. With vast Global, Regional and and Country level experience. Setting medical strategy, creating capability building programmes and empowering individuals. Winner of a global MSL excellence award in 2017-2018. And PharmaTimes MSL of the year 2018/2019 nominee. An academically and professionally proven diabetes and obesity specialist with 12 years experience working within the field of diabetes, in both academic and industry capacities. I excel at assimilating and communicating complex theory to medical professionals and managing key opinion leaders. Having completed my Diabetes UK sponsored PhD in obesity at one of the country’s leading universities I achieved outstanding academic results; including presenting my diabetes and obesity research findings at international conferences and having my work featured in a variety of medias including the Wall Street Journal and the Times of India. Alongside my academic accolades, I have also worked for a number of industry leading global pharmaceutical companies. I have a knowledge base which spans across all aspects of diabetes treatment, management and associated comorbidities. In short, I am an ambitious and dedicated individual with comprehensive pharmaceutical experience, scientific knowledge and excellent commercial acumen and passion for science and medicine.

## Experience
- **Director Global Medical Strategy and Execution** at LEO Pharma (Apr 2026 to present)
- **Medical Solutions Lead** at Sorcero (Nov 2025 to Apr 2026)
- **Director of Medical Excellence EUCAN** at Novo Nordisk (Jan 2025 to Oct 2025)
- **Director of Frontline Medical Excellence NW Europe** at Novo Nordisk (Mar 2021 to Jan 2025)
- **Chair** at Medical Science Liaison Association (Oct 2023 to Dec 2024)
- **MSL Team Lead** at Boehringer Ingelheim (Jul 2019 to Mar 2021)

## Education
- University of Bristol, Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), Diabetes and Obesity
- University of the West of England, BSc (Hons), Biomedical Sciences, General
